mapper.select: SELECT id, username, phone, email, password_hash, member_level, user_role, member_expire_time, avatar_url, avatar_object_key, auth_provider, wechat_openid, wechat_unionid, last_login_time, createtime, updatetime, createby, updateby, deleted, reserved1, reserved2, reserved3 FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND (username = #{account} OR phone = #{account} OR email = #{account}) LIMIT 1
